author: rsi_demo
title: G47 · 拒绝
body: I changed only matMul, combining the previously correct 3×3 output tile, one-time plain-left Float64Array materialization, and 16-way fused k unrolling while preserving the proven transposed-B layout, increasing-k accumulation order, conservative FMA eligibility, separate arithmetic fallback, and explicit edge tails. The other seven exports remain unchanged, so correctness risk is confined to a carefully tiled matrix kernel, while the historical 1.38× and 1.15× component factors project roughly 1.59× on matrix and should clear the aggregate gate if the additional unrolling does not regress.
